item.description: Archos #8690 the Twice-Born of the House of Chthonius fell (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.description: Kleos #2451 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Kleos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Antimon #9948 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to Iolcus.
